eligibility.reason: E1/E4: the reporter identifies versions, captures outgoing traffic, and restores communication with a local fix. E2 reaches step 6: libmavconn emits the wrong MAVLink wire framing to an AutoQuad peer that expects v1. E3: the observed outgoing-to-incoming link is PAIR. The internal flag bug affects a declared external wire interface and is therefore not excluded as internal or firmware-only.
eligibility.quote: When setting fcu_protocol to v1.0 with mavros 0.33 or later I faced problems communicating with my drone that still runs autoquad.

failed_conditions.quote: With mavros version >= 0.33 I was actually still sending mavlink v2.0 messages even after successfully setting the fcu_version=v1.0.
failed_conditions.reason: The failure is v2 versus v1 wire representation, not a ROS message-definition mismatch. The MAVLink start/magic field identifies that framing; the inspected fix changes the output-version flag in the status used by finalization.

loudness.quote: I also looked at the messages with [this](https://mavlink.io/en/guide/wireshark.html) wireshark plugin to double check.
loudness.reason: The framing defect is discovered by communication behavior and packet inspection, not a documented build/connection/activation diagnostic.
